faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bilaspur Project Technical Support-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the AIIMS Bilaspur Project Technical Support-III position is 04 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support-III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Technical Support-III post in the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bilaspur (AIIMS Bilaspur) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. in MLT or Life Sciences with 3 years of relevant experience, or an M.Sc. in MLT or Life Sciences in a relevant field to be eligible for the Project Technical Support-III position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Technical Support-III post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-III role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Technical Support-III position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 28000, along with HRA as admissible.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Bilaspur recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Technical Support-III post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Technical Support-III post includes Document Verification, a Written Test, and an Interview. Candidates must successfully clear all stages to be considered for the position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the AIIMS Bilaspur Project Technical Support-III recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to fill out and submit their applications through the official website or the provided online application link.

faq.question: Q9. Where is AIIMS Bilaspur located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Bilaspur is located in Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh. The recruitment is for candidates within this state.

faq.question: Q10. When is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview or reporting date for the AIIMS Bilaspur Project Technical Support-III recruitment is scheduled for 11 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they are available on this date.
